result:
I graded submission s2 for quiz 0001 and wrote `grades/0001-s2.json`. You got 3 correct, 2 partial and 1 wrong.

| Item | Verdict | Feedback |
|---|---|---|
| q1 | Correct | The loop is what makes a system an agent. |
| q2 | Correct | The model only writes a request naming the tool and its arguments. |
| q3 | Wrong (M6) | You picked "left to run longer, it will eventually fix the bug". After 40 identical failures, step 41 will fail the same way. The safeguard is a stopping condition such as a step limit. |
| q4 | Partial (M4) | 4 is right. But the model requests the tools and the program runs them, so the count is 4 because the model receives 4 inputs: the question and three tool results. |
| q5 | Correct | The result goes back as the next input, and the model uses it to decide its next step. |
| q6 | Partial | The name alone isn't enough. The model reads each tool's whole description: its name, what it does and its parameters. |

**Next step:** take one real makerspace request and write out what the model sees at each call, including the tool descriptions. Then write a full description for `check_calendar`. That also leads into context and memory.

I also added `learning-records/0003-loop-solid-tool-running-and-stopping-open.md` and updated `NOTES.md`. Submission s1 is still ungraded; I can grade it if you want to compare the two attempts.
